questions.q: What did Jacob mean by 'Ephraim and Manasseh, as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine'?
choices: They would serve Reuben and Simeon
He took Joseph's sons as his own, partakers of the same promises

questions.q: On whose head did Israel lay his right hand?
questions.explain: Guiding his hands wittingly, for Manasseh was the firstborn.

questions.q: Why was Ephraim set above Manasseh?
choices: Ephraim became the head of the Northern Kingdom of Israel
questions.explain: Truly his younger brother shall be greater than he.
